notes: This is a lightweight predictive-trigger comparison, not the final multi-UAM study.
The fixed reference is forecast from the already reconstructed corridor radio/policy field.
Predictive mode checks future no-action policy before candidate search; this isolated timing run sets reaction_latency_s=0 because no calibrated command delay is available.
Predictive candidates must complete before at least one forecast F sample; late candidates are retained for audit but rejected.
Only the nearest 100 m candidate shell can win the minimum-change objective; duration trials use a 20 s step.
Forecast step is 5 s (the policy sampling interval) and horizon is 180 s for a rapid, auditable run.
Singleton local-group exposure only; no traffic, ACC, capacity, or aviation certification.
